strategies.rationale: Introduces a compat shim that detects pydantic version at runtime and provides v1-style APIs on top of v2, allowing downstream code to remain unchanged while the library itself runs on v2. Preserves v1 method signatures (validator, BaseConfig, ROOT_KEY, parse_raw) via wrappers.
strategies.title: Compatibility Layer Migration

strategies.rationale: Fully rewrites internal implementation to use Pydantic v2 native patterns: model_config, field_validator, model_validator, native serialization, __pydantic_init_subclass__, and modern type system. Removes all v1 compatibility code. Updates public APIs only where v1 constructs are exposed (YamlModelMixin.parse_raw signature, YamlModel base class).
strategies.title: Native v2 Refactor
